answer_1.quote: We adopt competitive games, which are dynamic, resistant to saturation, and embed latent strategies, making them ideal for studying test-time learning.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include questions in Twenty Questions, verbal clues and votes in Who is Undercover, and mathematical problem solutions in AIME 2025.

answer_2.quote: Performance is measured by NDCG@20 based on the rank of the correct guess.

answer_4.quote: We recruited eight human participants to perform the same Twenty Question task, playing 20 rounds cumulatively.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to play the Twenty Questions game by asking up to twenty yes/no questions to identify a target word from a fixed set of 157 candidate words.
